title: Decide whether the share extension needs its own privacy manifest
acceptance: A determination, from Apple's current documentation, of whether an app extension bundle requires its own PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy for required-reason APIs it calls
If it does: StacksShareExtension gets one declaring the same UserDefaults reason
If it does not: the reasoning is recorded so App Review does not reopen it
notes: Surfaced reviewing T-0010. project.yml compiles Stacks/Services/AppGroup.swift into StacksShareExtension too, so the extension binary also calls UserDefaults — but T-0010's manifest lands only in the app bundle. Apple's guidance on per-extension manifests is ambiguous enough that this is a judgement call, not an implementation task. Kept out of T-0010 rather than widening its scope.
